semiconductor_relevance: High — Dandan Co., Ltd specializes in ceramic materials and coatings specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Dandan Co., Ltd is a supplier of advanced ceramic parts and coatings for major semiconductor and display companies in Korea. They offer in-house capabilities from material design to production, focusing on high-purity ceramics and next-generation plasma coating technologies.
capabilities: Sintered SiC and AlN ceramics for semiconductor applications
Y2O3 and YF3 plasma coatings to extend product life
Material design technology optimized for process conditions
In-house sintering and machining of high-purity ceramics

regional_presence.Korea: The company supplies its products to major semiconductor and display companies within Korea.
